description: This PHP script seeds quote data into the SuiteCRM system by creating Quote objects, associating ProductBundles and Products, and linking related notes and entities based on predefined seed data.

classes.name: Quote
classes.description: Represents a sales quote, with properties such as name, description, quote stage, addresses, and total amounts.

classes.name: ProductBundle
classes.description: Represents a bundle of products within a quote, including its stage, name, tax, shipping details, and relationships to products and notes.

classes.name: ProductBundleNote
classes.description: Represents notes or comments associated with a product bundle.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Represents a product item, with properties like name, quantity, price, status, and relationships to the quote and product bundle.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the entity (Quote, ProductBundle, Product, or Note) to the database.

methods.name: set_productbundle_product_relationship
methods.description: Creates a relationship between a product and a product bundle.

methods.name: set_product_bundle_note_relationship
methods.description: Links a note to a product bundle.

methods.name: set_productbundle_quote_relationship
methods.description: Associates a product bundle with a quote.
